_readme: How Pegasus starts each emulator. Only entries with verified=true are written as active 'launch:' lines; the rest are written commented out with a note asking the user to test and report. Every entry needs 'source' and 'verified_date' (for unverified entries: the date the source was last checked). Placeholders: {file.uri} / {file.path} are filled in by Pegasus.

profiles.verified_on: AYN Odin 2 Portal, Android 13, ARMSX2 2.7.x from the Play Store
profiles.source: Real device test by the project owner; see also https://github.com/inssekt/CocoonFE/pull/449
profiles.notes: The Play Store build keeps the package id 'come.nanodata.armsx2' (note: 'come', not 'com') but its classes moved to 'com.armsx2.*', so the fully qualified activity is required.

profiles.source: Package id of the GitHub release build. This exact line FAILED with ActivityNotFoundException on a Play Store install, so it only applies to the GitHub build.
profiles.notes: Only for the GitHub build of ARMSX2. If you installed ARMSX2 from the Play Store, use the Play Store profile instead.

profiles.launch:
am start --user 0
  -n com.retroarch.aarch64/com.retroarch.browser.retroactivity.RetroActivityFuture
  -e ROM {file.path}
  -e LIBRETRO /data/data/com.retroarch.aarch64/cores/snes9x_libretro_android.so
  -e CONFIGFILE /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.retroarch.aarch64/files/retroarch.cfg
  -e QUITFOCUS
  --activity-clear-top
  --activity-clear-task
  --activity-no-history
profiles.source: Pegasus docs, Platform Notes: Android (RetroArch64 example) https://pegasus-frontend.org/docs/user-guide/platform-android/
profiles.notes: Install the Snes9x core first (RetroArch → Online Updater → Core Downloader). The Play Store RetroArch uses the package 'com.retroarch' instead of 'com.retroarch.aarch64'.

profiles.launch:
am start --user 0
  -n com.retroarch.aarch64/com.retroarch.browser.retroactivity.RetroActivityFuture
  -e ROM {file.path}
  -e LIBRETRO /data/data/com.retroarch.aarch64/cores/mupen64plus_next_gles3_libretro_android.so
  -e CONFIGFILE /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.retroarch.aarch64/files/retroarch.cfg
  -e QUITFOCUS
  --activity-clear-top
  --activity-clear-task
  --activity-no-history
profiles.source: Pegasus docs, Platform Notes: Android (RetroArch64 example), core file name from the RetroArch core list https://pegasus-frontend.org/docs/user-guide/platform-android/
profiles.notes: Install 'Nintendo - Nintendo 64 (Mupen64Plus-Next)' first. If you get a black screen with the Vulkan driver, set the RDP plugin to ParaLLEl-RDP or use the gl driver for this core.

profiles.source: melonDS Android README, 'Launching from third-party frontends' (package, activity, ROM URI as intent data) https://github.com/rafaelvcaetano/melonDS-android
profiles.notes: melonDS needs the ROM folder scanned in its own settings first.

profiles.source: LaunchBox for Android help, 'Custom Emulator (With Code)' PPSSPP example https://feedback.launchbox-app.com/help/articles/7096169-custom-emulator-with-code

known_bad.why: This is the GitHub build's name. On a Play Store install of ARMSX2 it fails with "Activity not found".
This is an old ARMSX2 activity name that newer versions no longer have.
